name: devflow-plan
description: Whether a Devflow plan's cards are ready to be made: each a vertical slice, with criteria a test can check and the cards it waits on. Asked before the cards are created; the state is the planned cards, never the code.

vertical.instructions: Is every card a vertical slice: something that works end to end when it lands, rather than a layer or a step of another card?

criteria.true: each card's build ends in behaviour a person or a test can see
criteria.false: a card is only a layer (a schema, an endpoint with no caller) or half of another card

testable.instructions: Does every card have criteria a test can check, each one observable?

criteria.true: each card lists criteria, and each criterion names an input and what is seen
criteria.false: a card has no criteria, or one that no test could assert

dependencies.instructions: Are the dependencies stated and right: each card waits on the cards it needs, and on no card it does not?
